Meaning: Experimental owned bundle only. Both renderers use indexed per-view angle caching; the candidate additionally caches primitive vertex coordinates and delays segment-object lookup until the clipped span is on screen. Per-view paired calls alternate order; mapped flags are cleared before each call, fresh discovered bitsets are compared, then unioned with prior flags. Optional reference checks each cumulative hash. Cache validity clears every call; no cross-tic reuse. Timing includes cold calls, cache clear and map index setup; excludes renderer creation, flag reset and hashing. Not loaded-host or display FPS.
